title: ChemInform Abstract: HY253, a Novel Compound Isolated from Aralia continentalis, Induces Apoptosis via Cytochrome c‐Mediated Intrinsic Pathway in HeLa Cells.
abstract: AbstractChemInform is a weekly Abstracting Service, delivering concise information at a glance that was extracted from about 200 leading journals. To access a ChemInform Abstract of an article which was published elsewhere, please select a “Full Text” option. The original article is trackable via the “References” option.
